question.text: A piece of cheese is located at <math> <mrow> <mfenced> <mrow> <mn>12</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext> </mtext><mn>10</mn></mrow> </mfenced></mrow> </math> in a coordinate plane. A mouse is at <math> <mrow> <mfenced> <mrow> <mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext> </mtext><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow> </mfenced></mrow> </math> and is running up the line <math> <mrow> <mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>18</mn></mrow> </math> to get closer to the piece of cheese. At the point <math> <mrow> <mfenced> <mrow> <mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mtext> </mtext><mi>b</mi></mrow> </mfenced><mo>,</mo></mrow> </math> the mouse starts getting farther from the cheese rather than closer to it. Then the value of <math> <mrow> <mfenced> <mrow> <mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow> </mfenced></mrow> </math> is

solution.text:
a, b is the foot of the perpendicular from  12, 10 on the line y+5x=18


           


⇒   a - 1 2 5 = b - 1 0 1 = - 1 0 + 5 1 2 - 1 8 2 6

⇒   a, b = 2, 8
